schema.note: Dong Feng artifacts index — the single source of truth for datasets, checkpoints, and runs. Datasets/checkpoints/runs live under data/, checkpoints/, runs/ which are large and git-ignored; agents and the dfc CLI query THIS file (or the MCP server in tools/mcp_server.py) instead of reading those artifacts. Keep entries small: metadata and metrics only, never raw contents.

datasets.tokenizer: tokenizer id this dataset is tokenized for (or null)

runs.config: path or inline summary of the run config

schema.tokenizer_info_note: Built-in tokenizers are listed under the top-level `tokenizers` array; the MCP tokenizer_info tool reads it. `dfc data ingest` (re)registers them automatically.
